title: Independently check the GL3 length-seven refutation with LRAT hints
body:
The separate-checker handoff of #4242 left both saved GL3 refutations dependent on drat-trim's implementation. This adds a separately written Python positive-hint LRAT interpreter and freshly checks the unchanged **length-seven CNF**: 18,882 variables, 61,138 initial clauses, 8,558 checked additions and 2,420,732 hints, ending in empty clause72867. drat-trim only produces untrusted hints; its success message is never an acceptance condition.

The length-eight conversion hit its 512 MiB output-file limit (`SIGXFSZ`). Its exact failure is preserved and it was not independently replayed. This PR makes no length-eight, minimum-nine, human/kernel, physical caller, supplier or new-kappa claim. The existing support/normalization/CNF semantics audits remain separate credited dependencies.

Both registered Python3.12 normal/optimized warning-strict commands freshly replay the complete shorter certificate and 21 separately authored tests, including Boolean-model checks over138 formulas/1,581 direct-empty candidates and1,034 forged intermediate-clause attacks. Complete typed receipts match; immutable source-history preflight and a committed Git-free export pass with all30 files unchanged. A separate AI code/soundness/integration reviewer found no blocking defect. No independent human or formal proof-kernel review is claimed. Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl3-lrat-independent-check`.

Canonical main refreshed before submission remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7; selected record unchanged. All438 open/draft PR bodies plus an update-ordered delta and live board/hub/2102 checked; broader code/history/Discussion coverage partial, no novelty inference. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2102#discussioncomment-19093755). The formal-interface card is explicitly changed to this named certificate trust-link audit. No mechanism expansion. Only one isolated package is added. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge requested.

Remaining: independently validate the longer certificate under a measured resource plan; assemble exact model semantics, both refutations, padding and positive-witness dependencies; human/kernel acceptance; any actual charged physical caller and supplier/outer theorem. README/TASK give concrete follow-ups and stop rules.

Credit Brian Ross's strategy, direction, oversight, encoding/certificates with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Hanson Sun seed18/Josie Elliston three-register lineage; James Reed's pin/seal review; distinct #4214/#4223/#4230/#4242 audits; Marijn Heule/Nathan Wetzler's MIT drat-trim and original Glucose4/PySAT production. Original notices/licenses retained. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for the new checker, separately authored controls, integration and separate AI review. Established LRAT/RUP methods are not claimed as new general mathematics. New material Apache-2.0.
